pull.title: web: add audited job report enforcement controls
pull.body:
## Summary
- add an admin-only enforcement audit lookup for reviewed job reports
- expose `CANCEL_OPEN_JOB` from the existing moderation panel as a separate explicit action
- restore persisted enforcement state after reload and render its immutable audit details
- keep enforcement unavailable before a report is confirmed and rely on backend protections for non-OPEN jobs
- add backend regression coverage, responsive UI styling and trust/safety documentation

## Safety / privacy
- review and enforcement remain separate actions
- the control is shown only for `REVIEWED` reports and disappears once an enforcement audit exists
- active jobs, escrow and live tracking remain protected by the backend state guard
- enforcement audit data stays under the existing `ROLE_ADMIN` boundary and contains no private job location data

## Validation
Run Maven verify, frontend lint/build, Flyway/PostgreSQL/runtime smoke and existing payment/runtime gates. Do not merge unless required checks are green.

issue.title: ci: add CodeQL SAST for API and web
issue.body:
## Summary
- add GitHub CodeQL advanced setup for Java/Kotlin backend and JavaScript/TypeScript frontend
- use CodeQL Action v4
- run on pull requests to master, pushes to master, and a weekly scheduled scan
- build the Java API manually with Java 21 so compiled-code analysis follows the actual Maven project
- analyze JavaScript/TypeScript without a build step
- grant only contents:read and security-events:write

## Why
The repository has strong functional/runtime CI but no semantic static security analysis yet. This closes roadmap item #55 without changing application behavior.

## Validation before merge
- both CodeQL language jobs must complete successfully on the exact PR head
- normal CI must remain green
- master must remain unchanged before merge
- merge commit only, with expected head SHA
